title: Segment of Dumac Royal Tapestry
flavorText: One of ten thousand pieces of the cloth mosaic that adorned the halls of the Dwemer king. Supposedly awe inspiring when whole.
name: Segment of Dumac Royal Tapestry

title: Kwama Chitin Carved Nude
flavorText: An opalescent statue of a Dunmer at rest. It glistens in the light, giving it a slightly sweaty appearance.
name: Kwama Chitin Carved Nude

title: Miniature Ordinator Mask
flavorText: A recreation of an Ordinator's face mask in brass. The patina of tarnish and corrosion adds a splash of whimsy to the piece.
name: Miniature Ordinator Mask

title: Cast Ebony Statue
flavorText: A small mantel adornment from a run of works dubbed 'Anticipation' by an artist later executed for blasphemy by the Ordinators.
name: Cast Ebony Statue

title: Embossed Leather Picturebook
flavorText: The Conquests of Vivec' depicted on supple leather pages inviting to the touch, the proportions appear highly exaggerated.
name: Embossed Leather Picturebook

title: Dreugh Shell Idol
flavorText: This brownish-red likeness of Vivec has been shaped entirely out of dreugh carapace. It has a faint fishy scent.
name: Dreugh Shell Idol

title: Ancestor Ash
flavorText: This scrib husk's carapace has been inscribed with markings signifying the identity and renown of the Dunmer interred within.
name: Ancestor Ash

title: Morag Tong Oath
flavorText: A chapbook of the ritual pledge aspirants make on acceptance into the guild. A disclaimer states it is not proof of affiliation.
name: Morag Tong Oath

title: Cliff Racer Fetish
flavorText: An elaborate knot of cord and cliff racer plumes worn as a ward against the pests according to Ashlander superstition.
name: Cliff Racer Fetish

title: Desiccated Kogoruhn Beetle
flavorText: Some believe the profane whispers of long dead heretics can be heard when these Ashland carrion bugs are tucked into one's ears.
name: Desiccated Kogoruhn Beetle

title: Dunmeri Wraithshroud
flavorText: This ectoplasmic shroud has retained the appearance of its original manifestation, a sign of favor according to the Ashlanders.
name: Dunmeri Wraithshroud

title: Silvered Crescent Mirror
flavorText: This small thin sliver of silver has been polished to a mirror sheen. Daedra worshipers claim they speak to Azura through it.
name: Silvered Crescent Mirror

title: Inflated Netch Bladder
flavorText: Renowned for its rubbery properties. The bounciness of this preserved organ is a source of endless joy for people of all ages.
name: Inflated Netch Bladder

title: Greef or Teef Scorecard
flavorText: Used to tally the number of cheap shots the bearer has endured during a match of a popular tavern game pioneered by the Nords.
name: Greef or Teef Scorecard

title: Three-Stab Crony
flavorText: Condemned by the Tribunal Temple as heretical. This card game's rules and terminology paint the living gods as betrayers.
name: Three-Stab Crony

title: Kagouti Sled
flavorText: This kagouti crest has been fixed with rope handles and padding to facilitate an exhilarating plummet down tall ash piles.
name: Kagouti Sled

title: Pugilist Puppet
flavorText: This taxidermized cliff racer is traditionally stuffed with scrib jelly and suspended from a rope for children to bludgeon.
name: Pugilist Puppet

title: Champion Battle-Crab
flavorText: This weathered mudcrab is painted for war and bears notches in its shell for each of its victories in local crab dueling rings.
name: Champion Battle-Crab

title: Crock of Packing Mud
flavorText: Damp mineral rich clay sometimes used for skin care, but mostly employed in keeping mudcrabs fresh in transport.
name: Crock of Packing Mud

title: Basalt Balm
flavorText: This gritty mixture of pulverized volcanic rock and kwama ichor is believed to soothe burns and soften scars.
name: Basalt Balm

title: Strider Musk
flavorText: Bottled juices from select Silt Strider glands worn for the purposes of seduction. Use in wilderness settings is not advised.
name: Strider Musk

title: Hunger Tongue Comb
flavorText: This spongy hunk of muscle affixed to a wooden handle is considered ideal for the even application of Dunmeri hair gelatins.
name: Hunger Tongue Comb

title: Bobbin Lace Hairnet
flavorText: Bearing an elaborate pattern accented with beads, this netch lace has an elasticity prized among daring coiffure enthusiasts.
name: Bobbin Lace Hairnet

title: Chitinous Collapsible Razor
flavorText: This small shalk mandible is fitted with a hinge, allowing it to be stored compactly. Good for shaving and as a shell cracker.
name: Chitinous Collapsible Razor

title: Morag Tong Contract Stamp
flavorText: A red-stained seal stamp used on official contracts approved for execution. They are changed regularly to hamper forgery.
name: Morag Tong Contract Stamp

title: Racer Plume Quill
flavorText: This sharp-nibbed feather is colorful and flexible, though prone to drawing blood. Much like the creatures they originate from.
name: Racer Plume Quill

title: Kagouti Paperweight
flavorText: This polished skull of a kagouti hatchling has spines that align perfectly as a three-hole punch.
name: Kagouti Paperweight

title: Telvanni Ebon Quill
flavorText: This finely-pointed writing utensil can apply terminal punctuation to a sentence or a life with a flick of the wrist.
name: Telvanni Ebon Quill

title: Spillproof Scroll Paper
flavorText: Mildly enchanted with a ward against moisture that makes them incredibly impractical for most conventional forms of note taking.
name: Spillproof Scroll Paper

title: Kwama Shears
flavorText: Pearlescent mandibles perfect for trimming parchment or shredding unwanted manuscripts in only a few snips.
name: Kwama Shears

title: Kwama Egg Spoon
flavorText: An odd spoon designed to neatly slice the top off an egg, scoop the contents out, and deliver it safely into the owner's mouth.
name: Kwama Egg Spoon

title: Ashwood Spice Grinder
flavorText: This wooden container can be filled with an assortment of spices and twisted to shred the contents over a meal.
name: Ashwood Spice Grinder

title: Wax Ladle
flavorText: While utterly useless for most culinary applications, this dreugh wax ladle is one of the few things scrib jelly won't stick to.
name: Wax Ladle

title: Dreugh Corer
flavorText: A horrific coil of barbed metal wire employed to fish out every last morsel from the narrow segments of a cooked dreugh.
name: Dreugh Corer

title: Troubling Tines
flavorText: A plane fork. Its twisted shape supposedly traps Daedric essence for consumption, but it looks like an Ogrim did the chewing.
name: Troubling Tines

title: Numbing Needles
flavorText: These insect proboscis are commonly used to apply paralytic venom to overworked muscles or ease the pangs of Skooma withdrawal.
name: Numbing Needles

title: Shredded Finery
flavorText: It's impossible to tell what kind of clothing this article once was, but the cloth may be salvaged into a fetching kerchief.
name: Shredded Finery

title: Prized Antlers
flavorText: These horns look like they were torn off of the animal's skull, but are otherwise in excellent condition.
name: Prized Antlers

title: Loyal Hound's Charm
flavorText: This carved bone fetish is invoked by werewolves after a fresh kill to offer the spoils of their hunt to Hircine.
name: Loyal Hound's Charm

title: Gnarled Paw
flavorText: The paw of a wolf, mummified, and capped at the ankle with silver. Skaal believe it can ward away werewolves.
name: Gnarled Paw

title: Bloodmoon Pendant
flavorText: A necklace of rounded bone, pitted as if chewed, and stained deeply with blood. Carried by those hoping to join the Great Hunt.
name: Bloodmoon Pendant

title: Clockwork Dervish
flavorText: A key-operated device featuring a tiny puppet Mer in flowing silks. The figure bobs and twirls along to a jingling tune.
name: Clockwork Dervish

title: Scrib-Powered Fan
flavorText: A racer-wing spoked hub driven by a small wheel and axle. Propels a cooling breeze and the aroma of rancid meat.
name: Scrib-Powered Fan

title: Pedal Billows Mechanism
flavorText: This pedal and jumble of gears are core components to a larger forge stoking system that operates like a textile spinning wheel.
name: Pedal Billows Mechanism

title: Dwemeri Breathing Drill
flavorText: An ancient, but functional miniature crank drill believed to be used to clear stuffy sinuses.
name: Dwemeri Breathing Drill

title: Spring-Loaded Scrib Trap
flavorText: Much like a bear trap, but smaller and relying on narrow needle-like teeth to puncture a pesky scrib's shell.
name: Spring-Loaded Scrib Trap

title: Combination Sextant-Scope
flavorText: Can be used to chart, scout, and magnify small details on a map. Mind what portions are intended to be put to the eye.
name: Combination Sextant-Scope

title: False Drum
flavorText: This muted guar-skin drum contains a large hidden compartment useful for smuggling in bulk.
name: False Drum

title: Camonna Tong Vice Chits
flavorText: These wooden tokens are a form of currency issued by the syndicate to its most observant snitches. Valuable to the right people.
name: Camonna Tong Vice Chits

title: Gold Resin Scraper
flavorText: This scoop-like implement can harvest residue from most skooma pipes without damaging the delicate surfaces.
name: Gold Resin Scraper

title: Sugar Shaping Kit
flavorText: An assortment of silver scoops, presses, and other tools for compressing ground moon-sugar into assorted shapes and volumes.
name: Sugar Shaping Kit

title: Silt Strider Marionette
flavorText: This wood-carved Silt Strider dangles from a collection of silk strands. With a little practice it can be made to 'walk' around.
name: Silt Strider Marionette

title: Kwama Hand Puppet
flavorText: The hollowed-out head of a kwama worker drone, lined with canvas and stuffed for comfort. The mandibles are still quite sharp.
name: Kwama Hand Puppet

title: Sotha Sil Playset
flavorText: This brass figurine of the living god tinkers with a squirming mechanical animal via simple hand-operated mechanisms.
name: Sotha Sil Playset

title: Bonemold Training Sword
flavorText: This blunt practice blade was formed as a single solid piece of bonemold. It's flexible, sturdy, and leaves a mean welt.
name: Bonemold Training Sword

title: Articulated Ordinator Figurine
flavorText: The joints on this dark hardwood statue may be posed in a number of dramatic positions for optimal condemnation of heretics.
name: Articulated Ordinator Figurine

title: Compressed Ash Plates
flavorText: An unused stack of disposable dining ware made from pressed Ashland dust and kwama ichor. Perfect for casual entertaining.
name: Compressed Ash Plates

title: Repurposed Dwarven Pan
flavorText: The shiny concave vessel appears to have served some other function before being fitted with an iron handle to hold over a fire.
name: Repurposed Dwarven Pan

title: Bug Rendering Pot and Skimmer
flavorText: This hefty pot is made to withstand the high temperatures required to separate liquefied kwama guts from the outer chitin.
name: Bug Rendering Pot and Skimmer

title: Ornate Glassware
flavorText: This gorgeous glass is nearly shatterproof and beautifully etched with patterns popular among House Hlaalu.
name: Ornate Glassware

title: Hardened Fungus Decanter
flavorText: A whimsical vessel for liquids made by hollowing out and hardening an oversized toadstool through an alchemical process.
name: Hardened Fungus Decanter

title: Neen Clay Vase
flavorText: Seyda Neen's marshes hold earthy clay that turns a rich ruddy red when fired. Limited supply has this pottery in high demand.
name: Neen Clay Vase

title: Shalk Manacles
flavorText: The barbed mandibles of a giant beetle, shaped into a pair of painful bindings. Pulling free would leave deep wounds.
name: Shalk Manacles

title: Ear Bridle
flavorText: A curved iron rod pierced through a Mer's ears and screwed into place. Commonly lashed together to drive groups of prisoners.
name: Ear Bridle

title: Confiscated Sweetroll
flavorText: This stale confection has a steel file baked inside. Its seizure must have been doubly disappointing to someone.
name: Confiscated Sweetroll

title: Excruciator
flavorText: This small stone is enchanted to continually discharge weak Destruction spells when swallowed. Bears the seal of the Ordinators.
name: Excruciator

title: Brand of Excommunication
flavorText: An iron brand bearing the mark seared into the flesh of Temple functionaries who have failed the Tribunal. Applied to the cheek.
name: Brand of Excommunication

title: Vigilance Snuff
flavorText: A single ration of cheap alchemical powder to combat sleepiness. Bloodshot eyes are a common side effect in non-Dunmeri users.
name: Vigilance Snuff

title: Kwama Stick
flavorText: This oddly-shaped shaft of wood is used by egg miners to herd kwama. There is residue coating the tip that smells sickly-sweet.
name: Kwama Stick

title: Vvardvark Tongue Laces
flavorText: Long, stretchy strips of preserved tongue used for a variety of fastenings. Far more useful than leather, but less fashionable.
name: Vvardvark Tongue Laces

title: Deshedding Brush
flavorText: A tangle of metal wires used to accelerate the molting of guar. Requires a careful technique to avoid injury for both parties.
name: Deshedding Brush

title: Nix-Ox Brainspike
flavorText: A hefty Glass chisel tapered to a razor edge. Meant to slip through the carapace of a nix-ox's skull with a single hammer blow.
name: Nix-Ox Brainspike

title: Rough Sharpening Belt
flavorText: This high-grit strap of alit hide works best for bulk sharpening of large blades, such as axes. Should last for years.
name: Rough Sharpening Belt

title: Dental Axe
flavorText: Part saw, part axe. This jagged piece of metal prunes nix and kwama mandibles quickly, precisely, and with less loss of fingers.
name: Dental Axe

title: Fetcher Fly Pin Cushion
flavorText: The desiccated husk of a fetcher fly stuffed with sea sponge. This one is skewered with many needles and fetcher fly stingers.
name: Fetcher Fly Pin Cushion

title: Pearlescent Hand Mirror
flavorText: A painstakingly polished piece of scrib shell framed in copper. It produces an accurate, if colorful, reflection.
name: Pearlescent Hand Mirror

title: Steel Nit Comb
flavorText: This comb has long closely-spaced teeth to catch the numerous kinds of small bugs that will nest on the scalp or in wigs.
name: Steel Nit Comb

title: Ruddy Lip Paint
flavorText: A rich, dark red pigment derived from dreugh shell mixed with a guar-fat formula to stick to the lips. It smells greasy.
name: Ruddy Lip Paint

title: Dunmeri Hair Gelatin
flavorText: A popular formula of scrib-based hair product. This gel gives treated hair a wobbling bounciness. Technically edible.
name: Dunmeri Hair Gelatin

title: Molar Massager
flavorText: The rear portions of an alit's jaw bound to a carved ivory handle. The smooth bumpy texture is a relief to tender muscles.
name: Molar Massager

title: Hide Parasol
flavorText: The guar-hide stretched over this collapsible wooden frame is a reliable source of shade on the rare clear Ashland day.
name: Hide Parasol

title: Blood Jerky
flavorText: Dry, coagulated blood in the form of a puck. May be chewed or boiled down, but its nutritional value is questionable at best.
name: Blood Jerky

title: Periapt of Bal
flavorText: A string of teeth taken from bloodfiends and worn as a necklace. Vampires are said to consider them a symbol of their dominance.
name: Periapt of Bal

title: Subterranean Travel Map
flavorText: This hand drawn map points to a number of underground tunnel networks, though its age and accuracy aren't easily determined.
name: Subterranean Travel Map

title: Vampire Clan Lineage
flavorText: A scroll case containing the cryptic familial ties of a native vampire clan. A hunter's dream discovery.
name: Vampire Clan Lineage

title: Fang Rippers
flavorText: This cruel looking pair of silver pliers was designed to tear through the gums and pull a vampire's fangs out from the root.
name: Fang Rippers

title: Ash Foundation
flavorText: This particular mixture of volcano ash and binding agents is traditionally used for theatrical productions.
name: Ash Foundation

title: Red Mountain Kohl
flavorText: Finely pulverized volcanic glass typically worn around the eyes to give them a dramatic outline and scintillating aura.
name: Red Mountain Kohl

title: Nix Bristle Eyelashes
flavorText: Extremely fine yet firm 'hairs' from a nix-ox exoskeleton bound to a thin silk strip. Botched application may cause blindness.
name: Nix Bristle Eyelashes

title: Six Mushroom Scent
flavorText: This fragrance is a mixture of oils from Vvardenfell's most pungent fungi. The bottle advises shaking before application.
name: Six Mushroom Scent

title: Fetcherfly Lotion
flavorText: This smooth thick cream is made from straining a puree of crushed fetcherflies. The hazards of harvesting keep it in low supply.
name: Fetcherfly Lotion

title: Bone Blush
flavorText: This ivory powder pigment that was popular during the height of Argonian-horn fashion trend. Rarely found after the Pact formed.
name: Bone Blush

title: Tribunal Icon
flavorText: A dark iron symbol of the Tribunal Temple highlighted with gold. A choice said to symbolize the Chimer origins of the Dunmer.
name: Tribunal Icon

title: Tribunal Conversion Tract
flavorText: This small booklet warns against the misguided worship of the 'Eight Divines' in favor of the true divinity of the living gods.
name: Tribunal Conversion Tract

title: Blank Book of Verse
flavorText: Devotees of Vivec are given these tomes to capture their divine inspirations for prayer readings. Buoyant Armigers often attend.
name: Blank Book of Verse

title: Seht Time Orb
flavorText: This votive glass sphere clocks worship hours by channeling sand through unseen tunnels that form elaborate geometric patterns.
name: Seht Time Orb

title: Token of Divine Adoration
flavorText: Dunmer regularly buy these specially minted coins from Tribunal priests to offer at shrines of Almalexia while on Pilgrimage.
name: Token of Divine Adoration

title: Pocket Triptych of Saint Veloth
flavorText: Three detailed paintings of the Pilgrim's journey to Resdayn on a small silk folding screen. The colors are vivid when backlit.
name: Pocket Triptych of Saint Veloth

title: Netch-Leather Canteen
flavorText: A netch calf's rubbery dome, put through a vigorous tanning process and fitted with a chitin neck and stopper.
name: Netch-Leather Canteen

title: Bonemold Stein
flavorText: A sturdy and lightweight drinking vessel made from a multitude of cadaverous sources best not dwelled upon.
name: Bonemold Stein

title: Mushroom Cap Topper
flavorText: This preserved hunk of fungus can firmly stop most mugs, deterring any attempts to surreptitiously poison the owner.
name: Mushroom Cap Topper

title: Waterstones
flavorText: Calcified deposits found in dreugh organs that absorb fresh water and may be swallowed to stave off dehydration for a time.
name: Waterstones

title: Hlaalu Batch 42 Mazte Bottle
flavorText: This vintage shot up in value after a Temple canon's body was discovered stashed in the cask. Even the bottles retain value.
name: Hlaalu Batch 42 Mazte Bottle

title: Red Mountain Wine Glass
flavorText: This gleaming black volcanic glass swirls with smoky ash impurities deliberately added during the firing process.
name: Red Mountain Wine Glass

title: Fetcherfly Fly Lure
flavorText: The bristly husk of a dead fetcherfly with a metal hook in place of its stinger. Popular among Ashlander anglers.
name: Fetcherfly Fly Lure

title: Dreugh Repellant
flavorText: Concentrated dreugh excrement alchemically mixed with local mushrooms. Effective on dreugh or most anything that can smell.
name: Dreugh Repellant

title: Silt Strider Calf Rod
flavorText: Juvenile silt striders legs are ideal for fishing rods, though adult limbs are sometimes ship-mounted for deep sea fishing.
name: Silt Strider Calf Rod

title: Shroom-Wood Tackle Box
flavorText: The dried mushroom stem planks of this tackle box are remarkably light and buoyant. Edible too, if the fish aren't biting.
name: Shroom-Wood Tackle Box

title: Netch Tendril Drag-Net
flavorText: An incredibly pincer resistant mudcrab hauling net made from tightly woven netch tendrils.
name: Netch Tendril Drag-Net

title: Hunger Claw Filleting Knife
flavorText: The long, razor-thin claw of a Hunger mounted to an Ebony handle. Viscera tends to cling stubbornly to the blade.
name: Hunger Claw Filleting Knife

title: Concert Kwama Flute
flavorText: Hand-carved kwama limbs are the most common instruments in Vvardenfell, but few are capable of hitting a broad range of notes.
name: Concert Kwama Flute

title: Scrib Chimes
flavorText: Popular among parents with children, these segments of scrib are dangled from stings and struck to produce soft, hollow notes.
name: Scrib Chimes

title: Scrib Mouth-Harp
flavorText: A segment of scrib antenna mounted to a wood frame that produces a whimsical sound when placed between the teeth and plucked.
name: Scrib Mouth-Harp

title: Glass Strand Golg'leef
flavorText: This single string instrument is played by dragging a wide variety of bows across the wire. Most virtuosos are skilled jugglers.
name: Glass Strand Golg'leef

title: Armiger Dralayn's Endless Concerto
flavorText: The eccentric author of this sheet music has expanded on the piece by a movement every month for the last forty years.
name: Armiger Dralayn's Endless Concerto

title: Alit Molar Drum
flavorText: The back-teeth of bull alits make acoustically impressive drum bases, but the beasts rarely reach a viable size to harvest them.
name: Alit Molar Drum

title: Bone Bender Oil
flavorText: A shaping aid that temporarily softens bones and even teeth. In case of accidental ingestion, do not chew for thirty-six hours.
name: Bone Bender Oil

title: Bug Hammer
flavorText: This four faced mallet is used to warp and stretch chitin into shapes suitable for armoring. Sometimes used for pest control.
name: Bug Hammer

title: Bag of Nix Rivets
flavorText: A popular alternative to metal fasteners, both for their ready availability and resistance to most forms of corrosion.
name: Bag of Nix Rivets

title: Wraith Apron
flavorText: Lightweight and frigid, this ectoplasmic garment helps keep a hardworking smith from suffering heat exhaustion.
name: Wraith Apron

title: Netch Bellows
flavorText: This taxidermized bull netch has been fitted with a ceramic nozzle and sandwiched between two planks. Creates quite a breeze.
name: Netch Bellows

title: Indoril Commission Placard
flavorText: The brass plate on this placard announces that its owner has the blessing of House Indoril to fashion their holy vestments.
name: Indoril Commission Placard

title: Silent Auction Announcement Flyer
flavorText: An advertisement instructing the reader how to surreptitiously participate in an illegal slave auction.
name: Silent Auction Announcement Flyer

title: Inseams of Outlanders
flavorText: A pocket guide for tailors and armorers outlining all manner of typical measurements for the assorted races of Tamriel.
name: Inseams of Outlanders

title: Ash-Caked Sign
flavorText: A well-used sign meant to be hung outdoors. In need of a good scrubbing and new coat of paint, but otherwise in good condition.
name: Ash-Caked Sign

title: Plump Protrusions, A Spying and Selection Guide
flavorText: The most comprehensive edition of Vvardenfell's most popular mushroom almanac.
name: Plump Protrusions, A Spying and Selection Guide

title: Burnt Heresies
flavorText: Fire-damaged texts salvaged from an Ordinator pyre. Valuable to the bravest collectors and iconoclasts.
name: Burnt Heresies

title: Words of the Divine Poster
flavorText: A vintage print announcing one of Lord Vivec's poetry performances for the public. His likeness emits a feint glow.
name: Words of the Divine Poster

title: Indoril Death Mask
flavorText: The golden face mask purportedly buried with Indoril Nerevar, though there were many replicas fashioned for failed Nerevarines.
name: Indoril Death Mask

title: Grooming Tools of Dumac Dwarf-King
flavorText: A half-dozen highly specialized Dwarven implements for precision beard sculpting. There is, however, no razor.
name: Grooming Tools of Dumac Dwarf-King

title: Naggie the Nix-Ox
flavorText: Disappointed eyebrows are thickly embroidered on this stitched together nix-ox.
name: Naggie the Nix-Ox

title: Nasty the Netch
flavorText: Angry eyebrows are embroidered on this fabric netch, a strange addition given it has no eyes.
name: Nasty the Netch

title: Nappy the Nix-Hound
flavorText: Closed eyes have been embroidered on this felt nix-hound, giving it the appearance of peaceful slumber.
name: Nappy the Nix-Hound

title: Stuffed Cliff-Strider
flavorText: This replica almost exactly resembles an infant cliff-strider. Perhaps it's best not to bring it out when an adult is nearby.
name: Stuffed Cliff-Strider

title: Felt Vvardvark
flavorText: The button eyes of this twisted creature stare back at you. What force of nature allowed this thing to exist?
name: Felt Vvardvark

title: Kwama Warrior Plush
flavorText: This hefty doll might protect a little one while they went to bed, but its fearsome face is likely to cause nightmares for some.
name: Kwama Warrior Plush

title: Azura's Hand-Napkin
flavorText: At first this cloth appears to be a small tapestry depicting the symbols of Azura, but the food stains show its true purpose.
name: Azura's Hand-Napkin

title: Ashen Pillow
flavorText: The pillow is filled with ash, feeling more like a sack of sand than anything to sleep on.
name: Ashen Pillow

title: Handkerchief Quilt
flavorText: Families will often use old clothing to create a quilt. This one appears to be created from used handkerchiefs. Crafty.
name: Handkerchief Quilt

title: Handkerchief of Devotion
flavorText: This handkerchief is half-blue and half-yellow to honor the living god Vivec, though many frown on its use.
name: Handkerchief of Devotion

title: Vvardenfell Blanket
flavorText: An intricately woven blanket depicting a map of Vvardenfell, including the names of major towns embroidered into it.
name: Vvardenfell Blanket

title: Guar Blanket
flavorText: A patchwork blanket with an unpleasant odor. Useful for a traveling guar, or perhaps a desperate traveler.
name: Guar Blanket

title: 1001 Guar Enchantments
flavorText: A spellbook with instructions for guar specific enchantments. Very popular with mage-farmers, a niche audience.
name: 1001 Guar Enchantments

title: Stilted Dice
flavorText: Used in practical jokes, these dice always cause the player to lose. Outlawed from most cities after many resulting deaths.
name: Stilted Dice

title: Future Telling Crystal
flavorText: Though an initial success, these crystals were ultimately found to be enchanted to give randomized answers to any question.
name: Future Telling Crystal

title: Never Freezing Snowball
flavorText: This never melting snow is perfect for keeping drinks chilled, though this is not recommended due to its embedded enchantment.
name: Never Freezing Snowball

title: Color Changing Ink
flavorText: This ink is enchanted to constantly change color, making it ever popular with young students and ever hated by their teachers.
name: Color Changing Ink

title: Runic Ruby
flavorText: These gems are etched with a single, mysterious rune, thought to be discovered under Red Mountain.
name: Runic Ruby

title: Netch Softening Balm
flavorText: This lotion is used to soften a Netch's hide, helping it produce finer quality leather.
name: Netch Softening Balm

title: Thrice Used Bandages
flavorText: All manner of bodily fluids stain these bandages, so threadbare that they may come apart with a fourth use.
name: Thrice Used Bandages

title: Various Colored Pills
flavorText: There seems to be little to no consistency with the color, size, or purpose of each of these pills.
name: Various Colored Pills

title: Skull of a Slave
flavorText: An Argonian skull used in the study of slave behavior and health.
name: Skull of a Slave

title: Ashen Salve
flavorText: Healers all throughout Vvardenfell rave of the healing properties of fresh Red Mountain ash. Not working? Not fresh enough!
name: Ashen Salve

title: Necklace of Fingers
flavorText: The fingers that hang along the string are a variety of sizes and colors, making for a well-balanced but morbid collection.
name: Necklace of Fingers

title: Jar of Tentacles
flavorText: It's not apparent what manner of liquid keeps these Netch tentacles afloat, but it's thick and slightly yellow in color.
name: Jar of Tentacles

title: Decaying Dark Elf Scalp
flavorText: This would make for the most convincing toupee, if not for the stench of the rotting flesh still clinging to the hairs.
name: Decaying Dark Elf Scalp

title: Guar Tooth
flavorText: A large guar tooth, very popular with young children looking to add a bit of ferocity to their look.
name: Guar Tooth

title: Pouch of Golden Teeth
flavorText: Anyone can collect the teeth of their fallen enemies, but it's an artistic soul that takes the time to coat each one in gold.
name: Pouch of Golden Teeth

title: Phial of Dark Ooze
flavorText: Is this daedra blood? Ash tar? Perhaps ectoplasm? Most owners are too afraid to unscrew the cork to find out.
name: Phial of Dark Ooze

title: Vile Coin
flavorText: This black coin is used as a symbol for those devoted to the Prince of Bargains, for everything has a price.
name: Vile Coin

title: Raven's Feather
flavorText: Many devotees of Nocturnal will keep this with them for luck in their secretive endeavors.
name: Raven's Feather

title: Rose Carved Idol
flavorText: The wooden figurine is the basic shape of a woman, with no distinct features besides roses carved along her dress.
name: Rose Carved Idol

title: Almalexia Figurine
flavorText: One can't help but note that the figurine seems far more modestly dressed than the living goddess herself.
name: Almalexia Figurine

title: Sotha Sil Figurine
flavorText: Made of polished copper, the figurine holds a piece of clockwork within its tiny grasp, which it studies intently.
name: Sotha Sil Figurine

title: Vivec Figurine
flavorText: This vibrantly painted Vivec figurine seems to glow softly in darkness. Perhaps it's best not to touch it too often.
name: Vivec Figurine

title: Replica Blessing Stone
flavorText: For the devoted Dark Elf who wants the feeling of Lord Vivec's protection in their home.
name: Replica Blessing Stone

title: Red Mountain Hand Fan
flavorText: Displaying Red Mountain mid-eruption, this fan is usually bought by travelers, as most Vvardenfell natives deem it unlucky.
name: Red Mountain Hand Fan

title: Questionable Locket
flavorText: The portrait displayed within this locket shows a vaguely feline face, perhaps the depiction of someone's pet or lover.
name: Questionable Locket

title: Marble Kwama Egg
flavorText: This marble kwama egg is often used to decorate homes, though it may be off-putting to those not familiar with the delicacy.
name: Marble Kwama Egg

title: Ruby Fetcherfly Pendant
flavorText: The allure of this pendant is a mystery to many, but an avid group of collectors keep these odd pendants in pristine condition.
name: Ruby Fetcherfly Pendant

title: Pearl Kwama Figure
flavorText: A kwama intricately created from various sizes of pearls, this is often used to decorate shelves or dining tables.
name: Pearl Kwama Figure

title: Clockwork City Gear
flavorText: This gear is covered in various complex runes and shines a bright gold. Some light scratches show the copper underneath.
name: Clockwork City Gear

traitDescription: Increase experience gained from kills by 2.5%.

title: Monster: Domihaus
flavorText: A Monster Mask set found in Veteran Falkreath Hold.
name: Monster: Domihaus

title: Monster: Earthgore
flavorText: A Monster Mask set found in Veteran Bloodroot Forge.
name: Monster: Earthgore

title: The Precursor
flavorText: Back in order and ready to serve! Though it might not be the toughest target around, this eager to please factotum should at least hold up for another few thousand years.
name: The Precursor

title: Die Cut Icon of Sotha Sil
flavorText: This sheet of polished brass depicts the masked face of the Clockwork God in a highly stylized design.
name: Die Cut Icon of Sotha Sil

title: Freehand Schematic Sketches
flavorText: The early designs of an inventor who fancies interesting concepts over precise technical specifications.
name: Freehand Schematic Sketches

title: Fabricant Bug Collection
flavorText: This small shadowbox frame has several varieties of small clockwork insects nailed to the backboard. Many still operate.
name: Fabricant Bug Collection

title: Micro Etched Theories of Seht
flavorText: Within the illuminated borders of this record plate lies an entire volume of Seht's wisdom too small to read with the naked eye.
name: Micro Etched Theories of Seht

title: Flattened Skeevaton
flavorText: This once three dimensional skeevaton has been pneumatically pressed paper thin and fitted with a hook for wall mounting.
name: Flattened Skeevaton

title: Erotic Found Object Mosaic
flavorText: Assorted junk and scrap arranged to resemble provocative figures in repose, strategically oiled to give a glistening sheen.
name: Erotic Found Object Mosaic

title: Crow Feather Pinwheel
flavorText: These dark bird feathers have been bound together in the shape of a spoked wheel.
name: Crow Feather Pinwheel

title: Pitch Grease Paint
flavorText: Unnaturally black, this thick machine grease is believed to swallow the light when applied to the skin during Daedric rituals.
name: Pitch Grease Paint

title: Crusty Oil Spout
flavorText: The base of this steel barrel spout resembles a snake's fang and is clogged with dried blood.
name: Crusty Oil Spout

title: Crescent and Sun Combination Wrench
flavorText: This lovingly crafted tool integrates the imagery of Azura into each spanner, honoring her as the anticipation of Sotha Sil.
name: Crescent and Sun Combination Wrench

title: Desecrated Insect Fabricant
flavorText: Symbols of Namira have been carved into this grimy, metal bug. Whether they are the cause of its sorry state is anyone's guess.
name: Desecrated Insect Fabricant

title: Clockwork Jyggalag
flavorText: This heretical effigy of the dethroned Daedric Prince of Order seems uncomfortably at home in Seht's realm.
name: Clockwork Jyggalag

title: Nut Cracker
flavorText: This simple game involves scattering a pile of polished machine nuts outside a chalk circle by slamming a larger nut into them.
name: Nut Cracker

title: Angles and Arcs
flavorText: Played on a blackboard with a mathematical compass: players take turns calculating the most complex shapes in the shortest time.
name: Angles and Arcs

title: Manual of Factotum Tipping
flavorText: A favorite pastime of bored initiates. These instructions outline how to override some old model factotum gyroscopes.
name: Manual of Factotum Tipping

title: Captive Bearing Puzzle
flavorText: These brass-framed glass boxes contain intricate three dimensional labyrinths to be navigated by a steel bearing sealed inside.
name: Captive Bearing Puzzle

title: SPROING!
flavorText: A platter mounted to an industrial strength spring. Used for launching whatever's on hand for the most amusing results.
name: SPROING!

title: Die-Cast Dice
flavorText: Every die in this bag is a solid brass polyhedron with a multitude of faces, for games that are a secret between Apostles.
name: Die-Cast Dice

title: Tooth Lacquer
flavorText: This sepia tone sealant is brushed over one's teeth to protect from the corrosives found in most of Clockwork City's fluids.
name: Tooth Lacquer

title: Homebrew Emulsifier Puck
flavorText: These pot-rendered fats and chemicals are molded and dried for storage. Foams in contact with body oils for effective cleansing.
name: Homebrew Emulsifier Puck

title: Sinus Flush
flavorText: A vial of artificial-lavender scented degreaser and syringe used to clear accumulated grime out of airways.
name: Sinus Flush

title: Harmonic Recycomb
flavorText: The teeth of this improvised comb once served to produce notes in a music box and still produce crisp tones when freed of hair.
name: Harmonic Recycomb

title: Skin Blaster
flavorText: This handheld machine blows exfoliating grit through a pressurized nozzle to smooth skin. Careful calibration is advised.
name: Skin Blaster

title: Coif Stapler
flavorText: It's hard to manage oil saturated hair, but this spring loaded device will fasten locks securely to scalps and headgear alike.
name: Coif Stapler

title: Narrow Steel Graver
flavorText: While thin, this rigid engraving tool has no trouble carving into the metal plates Clockwork Apostles use for record keeping.
name: Narrow Steel Graver

title: Record Binder
flavorText: This book-like object has pages and pages of leather sleeves for storing record plates. Monstrously heavy when full.
name: Record Binder

title: Corrective Grease
flavorText: The pitch-black grease in this tin dries quickly and is used to blot out undesired engravings on record plates.
name: Corrective Grease

title: Wax Facsimile Kit
flavorText: Materials to take a wax impression from a record plate. Such copies have a short shelf life, but spare a lot of back pain.
name: Wax Facsimile Kit

title: Blank Mongrel Sheaf
flavorText: A stack of coveted paper medium made from pulverizing and reconstituting older records into mottled, ink-stained pages.
name: Blank Mongrel Sheaf

title: Apostle Auto-Stamper
flavorText: When pressed firmly onto a surface, a spring-loaded embossed stamp slams down with enough force to leave an impression.
name: Apostle Auto-Stamper

title: Dainty Dining Saw
flavorText: A table saw for those determined to serve fabricant cuts 'on the bone.'
name: Dainty Dining Saw

title: Nutriment Paste Whisk
flavorText: Sotha Sil's nutriment paste is intended for immediate consumption, but this whisk can reconstitute it should separation occur.
name: Nutriment Paste Whisk

title: Portable Ingestion Tube
flavorText: Holds nutriment paste for travel when securely capped. Squeeze and roll for best results.
name: Portable Ingestion Tube

title: Dwarven Nutcracker
flavorText: This weighty hunk of Dwarven metal earned its name for its effectiveness in knocking exposed fastenings off shelled fabricants.
name: Dwarven Nutcracker

title: Meat Extruder
flavorText: Rotating screws pulverize and squeeze meat through a sieve, preventing shrapnel from polluting the organic portions.
name: Meat Extruder

title: Palatizer
flavorText: A popular invention that prepares the user's tongue for a meal by rendering it completely taste-numb.
name: Palatizer

title: Gnawed Fabricant Leg
flavorText: Strips of pale meat still cling to this heavily distressed metal limb. Chew at your own risk.
name: Gnawed Fabricant Leg

title: Moondial
flavorText: A pocket-sized, clockwork device that displays the phases of the moons.
name: Moondial

title: Hair-Choked Mechanism
flavorText: Whatever this was appears to have been torn from a machine after a large animal got its fur caught in the workings.
name: Hair-Choked Mechanism

title: Nose Numbing Salts
flavorText: The aroma given off by this alchemical concoction helps alleviate the overwhelming smells of industry for a sensitive nose.
name: Nose Numbing Salts

title: Overclocked Skeevaton
flavorText: Heavily modified, this skeevaton can move at tremendous speed over most surfaces. Shows teeth marks.
name: Overclocked Skeevaton

title: Silver Quickener
flavorText: This highly specialized solvent will dissolve silver objects and even leach silver out of composite materials within minutes.
name: Silver Quickener

title: Crank Buffer
flavorText: A hand-powered device meant to rapidly polish broad metal surfaces, a task mostly left to factotums when it can be helped.
name: Crank Buffer

title: Factotum Anatomy Miniature
flavorText: This doll-sized replica factotum opens to reveal many of the inner workings for study.
name: Factotum Anatomy Miniature

title: Clockwork Clock
flavorText: This complex nest of gears is precisely timed to rotate a series of numbers in synchronicity with a typical Nirn day.
name: Clockwork Clock

title: Muting Muffs
flavorText: When cupped over the ears, these insulated metal bowls drown out all the abundant outside noise of Clockwork City.
name: Muting Muffs

title: Defunct Perpetual Motion Machine
flavorText: Many Clockwork Initiates attempt to craft mechanisms sustained under their own power. Most wind up as amusing collectables.
name: Defunct Perpetual Motion Machine

title: Study Buddy
flavorText: A combination record holder, chin rest, and eyelid speculum for apostles whose studies can't afford to be interrupted by sleep.
name: Study Buddy

title: Hollow Gear
flavorText: The secret compartment in this gear is used for smuggling skooma across the Brass Fortress.
name: Hollow Gear

title: Counterfeit Moon-Sugar
flavorText: The mysterious grains in this sack have been altered to highly resemble and smell like pure moon-sugar.
name: Counterfeit Moon-Sugar

title: Metal Smoking Pipe
flavorText: This pipe seems to be melded from assorted metals, giving the skooma smoked from it a metallic flavor.
name: Metal Smoking Pipe

title: Copper Hookah
flavorText: This once gleaming smoking device is now blackened with smoke after years of use.
name: Copper Hookah

title: Steel Cleaning Brush
flavorText: This thin scouring brush is made of steel wires and used to clean the nooks and crannies of hookahs.
name: Steel Cleaning Brush

title: Moon-Sugar Distillation Set
flavorText: This alchemical equipment has been tweaked to help distill moon-sugar into skooma.
name: Moon-Sugar Distillation Set

title: Tin Row Boat
flavorText: This little, silver boat is light enough to float atop the oily waters of Clockwork City.
name: Tin Row Boat

title: Verminous Fabricant Figurine
flavorText: Molded mid-snarl, this metal figure was made with an almost frightening attention to detail.
name: Verminous Fabricant Figurine

title: Connectable Pipe Set
flavorText: This assortment of different shaped pipes can be interconnected to make new pipeline systems.
name: Connectable Pipe Set

title: Wind-Up Skeevaton
flavorText: This popular toy looks just like the real thing, and can even roll across the floor after being wound up.
name: Wind-Up Skeevaton

title: Factotum Figure
flavorText: This model has many available poses, and even plays recorded messages at the press of a button.
name: Factotum Figure

title: Apostle's First Alchemy Set
flavorText: A number of small vials, bottles, and mostly harmless ingredients meant to incite curiosity and learning.
name: Apostle's First Alchemy Set

title: Gear Fanatic Frying Pan
flavorText: The bottom of this frying pan was made in the shape of a gear, making it nearly useless for cooking.
name: Gear Fanatic Frying Pan

title: Rusty Bowl
flavorText: This metal bowl has seen years of use and has begun to show rust within it.
name: Rusty Bowl

title: Lumpy Metal Plates
flavorText: These malformed plates are used by the Tarnished in Brass Fortress, and known to quickly rust.
name: Lumpy Metal Plates

title: Molded Medals Vase
flavorText: Copper and gold have been intricately layered to create a beautiful pattern on this vase.
name: Molded Medals Vase

title: Off-Balance Decanter
flavorText: This glass decanter was designed to lie slightly crooked on its side, making it difficult to keep balanced.
name: Off-Balance Decanter

title: Non-Sitck Pot
flavorText: The bottom of this pot is coated in a slippery substance that creates a protective barrier against sticky foods.
name: Non-Sitck Pot

title: Brass Nightstick Brooch
flavorText: This is a symbol of moderate rank among the Brass Fortress guards.
name: Brass Nightstick Brooch

title: Brass Fortress Badge
flavorText: This badge is worn by all Brass Fortress guards, a subgroup of the Clockwork Apostles.
name: Brass Fortress Badge

title: Brass Fortress Patrol Schedule
flavorText: A timetable schedule of guards' shifts and duties, now outdated by a few weeks.
name: Brass Fortress Patrol Schedule

title: Adjustable Handcuffs
flavorText: These useful handcuffs are magically enhanced to shrink or grow to the size of a captive's wrist.
name: Adjustable Handcuffs

title: Depleted Tracker Device
flavorText: This now-powerless metal device was designed to track the whereabouts of known criminals.
name: Depleted Tracker Device

title: Outdated Factotum Override
flavorText: This device was used to override aggressive factotums, though it is now obsolete due to new factotum enhancements.
name: Outdated Factotum Override

title: Robust Plant Clippings
flavorText: These clippings come from the healthiest plants growing in the Everwound Wellspring.
name: Robust Plant Clippings

title: Sturdy Leaf Shears
flavorText: These clippers are sharp enough to cut through the thick stems of Clockwork City's metallic trees.
name: Sturdy Leaf Shears

title: Nutrient Pellets
flavorText: Made from leftover gruel provided to Brass Fortress citizens, these bland pellets are used to feed livestock.
name: Nutrient Pellets

title: Metallic Saddle
flavorText: This saddle has been painted over with a variety of metallic paints, making it too gaudy for daily use.
name: Metallic Saddle

title: Airtight Containers
flavorText: Created for the Everwound Wellspring, these containers allow fresh food to travel across Clockwork City.
name: Airtight Containers

title: Alchemical Nutrients
flavorText: This alchemical solution is used to help plants within the Everwound Wellspring grow.
name: Alchemical Nutrients

title: Rusted Wavy Hairband
flavorText: This zig-zag hairband of thick wire, though now rusted to an unusable state, once helped keep hair pulled back.
name: Rusted Wavy Hairband

title: Fine Wire Brushes
flavorText: The brushes of these various makeup brushes are created with extremely thin wire.
name: Fine Wire Brushes

title: Oil-Be-Gone
flavorText: This solution was created to help quickly clean tough oil stains. Just apply and watch its magic work!
name: Oil-Be-Gone

title: Illuminated Hand Mirror
flavorText: The brass frame of this mirror contains small lights which brighten the user's face.
name: Illuminated Hand Mirror

title: Broken Magnifying Goggles
flavorText: Popular with Clockwork Apostles, these goggles once allowed the wearer to see the smallest detail.
name: Broken Magnifying Goggles

title: Augmentation Polisher
flavorText: This small device has been enchanted to vibrate as it buffs the brass appendages of the Clockwork Apostles.
name: Augmentation Polisher

title: Bent Shaded Spectacles
flavorText: The invention of a sun-hating apostle who often wore a pair, these spectacles have been bent to an unusable state.
name: Bent Shaded Spectacles

title: Blood Capsules
flavorText: The creation of an apostle of eccentric appetites, these inedible and unbreachable capsules contain a vial's worth of blood.
name: Blood Capsules

title: Blood Research Notes
flavorText: Notes of the effects of drinking blood from various races and ages. These are a popular guide among vampires.
name: Blood Research Notes

title: Sun-Blocking Lotion
flavorText: Created by an unusually sun-averse apostle, this lotion helps avoid sunburns, but was otherwise deemed a failure by its creator.
name: Sun-Blocking Lotion

title: Fabricated Blood
flavorText: This alchemical concoction was created by a passionate young apostle. Nauseating to consume, it smells and tastes of blood.
name: Fabricated Blood

title: Vampiric Experiment Log
flavorText: The dates and times of rather grisly-sounding vampire-related experiments performed by the Clockwork Apostles.
name: Vampiric Experiment Log

title: The Imperfect's Core Functions
flavorText: The code on this sequence plaque is believed to be the core functions of the Imperfects, though it has yet to be understood.
name: The Imperfect's Core Functions

title: Oily Kohl
flavorText: This greasy eyeshadow gives off a strong scent and is known to cause irritation if worn too long.
name: Oily Kohl

title: Concocted Lotion
flavorText: No one quite knows what the Tarnished use to create this odd-smelling lotion, but it's popular for dry skin and mild rashes.
name: Concocted Lotion

title: Waterproof Rouge
flavorText: This vibrant red lipstick is known for its popular motto, 'Water-tight and everlasting!'
name: Waterproof Rouge

title: Essence of Alloy
flavorText: This perfume gives off a heady metallic scent. Popular with apostles who have yet to undergo body modification.
name: Essence of Alloy

title: Brass Lip Gloss
flavorText: Lip gloss that has a shiny, brass finish, a current fashion trend among apostle students.
name: Brass Lip Gloss

title: Metallic Blush
flavorText: Flecks of gold and silver cause this blush to shine in the light.
name: Metallic Blush

title: Scrap-Metal Idol of Seht
flavorText: Multiple pieces of metal have been melted down to create this miniature likeness of Sotha Sil.
name: Scrap-Metal Idol of Seht

title: Brass Cufflinks of Vivec
flavorText: These small, brass cufflinks depict the icon of a harp and spear, the symbols of Vivec.
name: Brass Cufflinks of Vivec

title: Ivory Pendant of Almalexia
flavorText: A large, round cameo pendant made of ivory displaying a side profile of Almalexia's face.
name: Ivory Pendant of Almalexia

title: Gear of Sotha Sil
flavorText: A large gear, imprinted with the symbol of Sotha Sil. Said to bring good luck during examinations.
name: Gear of Sotha Sil

title: Clockwork City Globe
flavorText: This globe represents a miniature Clockwork City, as viewed from the outside.
name: Clockwork City Globe

title: Sublime Piston Model
flavorText: This golden piston is a constant reminder for all to walk towards the path of Nirn-Ensuing.
name: Sublime Piston Model

title: Satchel Canteen
flavorText: This leather canteen is made from herbalist's satchels. Any drink remains fresh, though ultimately turns extremely bitter.
name: Satchel Canteen

title: Tin Wine Bottle
flavorText: This unusual bottle quickly gives any wine poured into it a heady metallic tang.
name: Tin Wine Bottle

title: Purification Bottle
flavorText: This metal bottle was created to purify Clockwork's oily water, though the liquid still maintains its foul taste.
name: Purification Bottle

title: Gearhead Stein
flavorText: The handle is comprised of welded together gears, making handling this stein extremely difficult.
name: Gearhead Stein

title: Rare Wooden Mug
flavorText: Wooden mugs are uncommon due to the lack of natural wood within Clockwork City.
name: Rare Wooden Mug

title: Gleaming Seht Goblet
flavorText: This bright, brass goblet has gears and torches engraved upon it, representing the crest of Sotha Sil.
name: Gleaming Seht Goblet

title: Steel Landing Net
flavorText: This fishing net is created entirely from wire, making it very durable but quick to rust.
name: Steel Landing Net

title: Fabricant Bait
flavorText: Chunks of fabricant flesh used as fish bait. Some metallic bits still cling to the flesh.
name: Fabricant Bait

title: Factotum-Finger Sinkers
flavorText: These broken-apart bits of rusted factotum fingers are used to sink fishing lines.
name: Factotum-Finger Sinkers

title: Automatic Fishing Rod
flavorText: This fishing rod automatically pulls in your line. Useful for catching heavy fish, or for very lazy fishers.
name: Automatic Fishing Rod

title: Glowing Lure
flavorText: This fishing lure is used to attract the strange creatures living within the dark waters of Clockwork City.
name: Glowing Lure

title: Fishing Line Wire
flavorText: This extremely thin and durable wire is perfect for reeling in a big catch.
name: Fishing Line Wire

title: Rubbish Chimes
flavorText: These chimes are cluttered with a collection of metallic objects, found in the scrap piles of Brass Fortress.
name: Rubbish Chimes

title: Brass Triangle
flavorText: Popular among young mages, the single chime of this triangle helps bring thoughts back into focus.
name: Brass Triangle

title: Unidentifiable Instrument
flavorText: This multi-piece instrument brings to mind a flute, though it's unclear where one would put their mouth.
name: Unidentifiable Instrument

title: Waltz of the Gears
flavorText: The musical notation on this sequence plaque is extremely complicated, though quite imaginative.
name: Waltz of the Gears

title: Prized Wooden Lute
flavorText: A common lute by any standards, this instrument is cherished in Clockwork City where wood is in short supply.
name: Prized Wooden Lute

title: Musical Sphere
flavorText: This small, brass ball chimes in reaction to magical impulses. Thought to help with arcane projects.
name: Musical Sphere

title: Broken Firepot Disruptor
flavorText: This tonal dampener was originally created to stun firepot spiders, allowing blacksmiths to siphon their oil.
name: Broken Firepot Disruptor

title: Brass Pliers
flavorText: Found to be ultimately useless because of their low melting point, these pliers are instead used for decorative purposes.
name: Brass Pliers

title: Fabricant Leather Apron
flavorText: This patchwork rawhide apron comes from the various fabricants which live in Clockwork City.
name: Fabricant Leather Apron

title: Piston Hammer
flavorText: The piston attached to this hammer's head improves its power and precision.
name: Piston Hammer

title: Automatic Bellows
flavorText: The automatic pump action of these bellows isn't long lasting, but help cut back physical labor in the long run.
name: Automatic Bellows

title: Self-Turning Vise
flavorText: This blacksmithing vise grips and loosens objects at the press of a pedal.
name: Self-Turning Vise

title: Forged Artificer Badge
flavorText: This badge is a replica of those given by artificers legally recognized by the Clockwork Apostles.
name: Forged Artificer Badge

title: Melted Sequence Plaque
flavorText: This metal plate has undergone intense heat, making the engravings written upon it indecipherable.
name: Melted Sequence Plaque

title: Maintenance Work Request
flavorText: A long and detailed form, filled with neat handwriting, asking for a various repairs in the Brass Fortress
name: Maintenance Work Request

title: Journal of Innovation
flavorText: This blank, brass journal is given to apostles to write down their ideas and experiments.
name: Journal of Innovation

title: Seht's Sermons Pocket Guide
flavorText: This small booklet contains shortened and simplified versions of Sotha Sil's Sermons.
name: Seht's Sermons Pocket Guide

title: Inspirational Poster
flavorText: Often found in the rooms of young apostles, this poster is inscribed with inspirational quotes and messages.
name: Inspirational Poster

title: Sotha Sil's Notes
flavorText: With its nearly indecipherable writing, this is thought to be one of the hundreds of notes Sotha Sil creates on any given day.
name: Sotha Sil's Notes

title: Vigilance Tonic
flavorText: Generally used to combat drowsiness, this tonic is often used by young apostles to help with their concentration during studies.
name: Vigilance Tonic

title: Cruddy Man
flavorText: A popular type of crude dreugh doll stitched from an assembly of smudged rags and, not coincidently, the color of dried blood.
name: Cruddy Man

title: Stuffed Seht Effigy
flavorText: This adorable and slightly blasphemous depiction of Sotha Sil was once a pillow that now has mechanical bits stitched into it.
name: Stuffed Seht Effigy

title: Oil-filled Netch Doll
flavorText: A synthetic bladder adorned with rubbery tubing and filled with thick fluid. Satisfying to squeeze, but always slightly greasy.
name: Oil-filled Netch Doll

title: Painted Cog
flavorText: The mounting hollows of this gear resemble a smiling face, an effect pronounced by the clever application of enamel paints.
name: Painted Cog

title: Pristine Wax Lady
flavorText: This dignified depiction of a Dunmer is clothed in fine, hand-crafted miniature garb. Posable with careful application of heat.
name: Pristine Wax Lady

title: Fabricant Leather Chimera
flavorText: A fantastical, or horrifyingly inaccurate, stuffed animal patched together from assorted fabricant skins.
name: Fabricant Leather Chimera

title: Preservation Bag
flavorText: Air tight for vacuum sealing, this thin rubber pouch is large enough to store a perishable research sample or small meal.
name: Preservation Bag

title: Hand-woven Bindle Cloth
flavorText: Fibers of assorted exodromal rags were respun into a course yarn to make up this study carrying cloth. All it needs is a stick.
name: Hand-woven Bindle Cloth

title: Sponge Towel
flavorText: Native synthetic sponge modeled upon natural sea sponge to wick moisture out of machinery. Occasionally borrowed for bathing.
name: Sponge Towel

title: Thermal Conductive Mesh
flavorText: A flexible weave of wire and rubber now encased in cloth and repurposed as a blanket.
name: Thermal Conductive Mesh

title: Industrial Strength Doily
flavorText: What was most likely once a precision steam gasket, now spends its time protecting surfaces from hot pots.
name: Industrial Strength Doily

title: Ornamental Mail Table
flavorText: Polished nuts and wire arranged like beadwork into a patterned table covering that could probably stop an axe blow.
name: Ornamental Mail Table

title: Apostle's Lubricant Oils
flavorText: A pouch of tiny vials filled with alchemical oils meant to be applied to their bodily enhancements for regular maintenance.
name: Apostle's Lubricant Oils

title: Odorless Waste Vessel
flavorText: This brass pot can contain all manner of filth without the associated fumes escaping. May cause suffocation.
name: Odorless Waste Vessel

title: Carving Quill
flavorText: This angular metal quill effortlessly scratches grooves into metal surfaces. Popular among scribes and Tarnished vandals.
name: Carving Quill

title: Magic Metronome
flavorText: When placed upon a machine, this device automatically adjusts the timing of the mechanisms according to the user's settings.
name: Magic Metronome

title: Light Recycler
flavorText: An array of lens, mirrors, cogs, and spokes that focuses light into a crystal providing a warm yellow glow into the late hours.
name: Light Recycler

title: Dovah-Fly Swatter
flavorText: This comically long tuning fork can shatter the tiny fluttering automatons into a thousand pieces with the slightest touch.
name: Dovah-Fly Swatter

title: Fabricant Flenser
flavorText: An adjustable aperture stop with razor-sharp edges. Highly effective in stripping flesh from endoskeletons of all kinds.
name: Fabricant Flenser

title: Soothing Intestinal Balm
flavorText: This chalky fluid coats the mouth, throat, stomach, and anything else with a mild corrosive protectant. May inhibit digestion.
name: Soothing Intestinal Balm

title: Artificial Skin Patches
flavorText: For reasons unknown, fabricant flesh preserved in the right oils make effective temporary grafts over serious injuries.
name: Artificial Skin Patches

title: Anesthetizer Coil
flavorText: Renders living tissue numb through several minutes of excruciating, highly focused shocks.
name: Anesthetizer Coil

title: Blood Billows
flavorText: Rubber bladders manually compressed to circulate a patient's blood, preferably by a factotum, or someone with excellent rhythm.
name: Blood Billows

title: Servo-Splint
flavorText: This mechanized brace not only supports an injured or infirm limb, but also lends the strength of a slightly less frail person.
name: Servo-Splint

title: Love Sprocket
flavorText: Superstitious Tarnished carry these salvaged wheels, believing meeting someone with a matching assembly will mean true love.
name: Love Sprocket

title: Impractical Nasal Kerchief
flavorText: This remarkably soft rubber square is folded haphazardly and presently stuck that way.
name: Impractical Nasal Kerchief

title: Ectoplasmic Grease
flavorText: Some claim this ghostly residue implies fabricated beings have souls, but superstitions don't outweigh its lubricant value.
name: Ectoplasmic Grease

title: Mummified Factotum Face
flavorText: Left over from an attempt to make factotums relatable, it's impossible to tell if this desiccated mask was created or harvested.
name: Mummified Factotum Face

title: Bronzed Apostle Hand
flavorText: An infrequently observed tradition among the Clockwork Apostles is to enshrine their amputated body parts after replacement.
name: Bronzed Apostle Hand

title: Self-Chewing Teeth
flavorText: These grotesquely exaggerated metal jaws may be wound to chew according to prescribed mastication settings for several minutes.
name: Self-Chewing Teeth

title: Votive Statue of Seht
flavorText: This figurine depicts Seht offering a guiding hand. They are presented to new Clockwork Initiates after induction to the order.
name: Votive Statue of Seht

title: Drinking Fabricant
flavorText: This simple likeness of a verminous fabricant bobs its head down and then rights itself periodically by some unseen force.
name: Drinking Fabricant

title: Lazy Ratter
flavorText: The cat-like shape of these small lead statues are supposedly the reason why they're effective at keeping skeevatons at bay.
name: Lazy Ratter

title: Mantle Minder
flavorText: These automatons repeat a simple action for display, though some have limited utility, such as dusting themselves.
name: Mantle Minder

title: Whittled Wire Worker
flavorText: Once the branch of a fabricated tree, this golden statue of a factotum has all the grain and texture of a wood carving.
name: Whittled Wire Worker

title: Screecher
flavorText: Part decoration, part security measure, this bird-like automaton emits a grating metal squeal when approached.
name: Screecher

title: Fabricant Brands
flavorText: Those who presume to lay claim to a tamed fabricant sometimes affix a metal badge to its chassis as a mark of ownership.
name: Fabricant Brands

title: Knot Bauble
flavorText: The Tarnished often decorate their hovels with small charms and figures made from twisted wire and loose scrap.
name: Knot Bauble

title: Scrapourri
flavorText: The trend of leaving vessels filled with polished scrap and scented oils about a dwelling is catching on in the Brass Fortress.
name: Scrapourri

title: Prized Maplewood Stick
flavorText: Even the simplest reminders of the living world are a rare comfort to those stranded in Clockwork City.
name: Prized Maplewood Stick

title: Sculpting Stone
flavorText: The thick crust of small metal bits cling to this powerful lodestone are easily shaped into simple designs for amusement.
name: Sculpting Stone

title: Coil Chimes
flavorText: A small set of particularly melodic machine coils repurposed to be hung by ventilation shafts and provide soft background noise.
name: Coil Chimes

title: Vintage Factotum Fabrication Orders
flavorText: This machine cogitation plate contains a design template for early generation factotums. It's in near mint condition.
name: Vintage Factotum Fabrication Orders

title: Quicksilver Visualizer
flavorText: The liquid metal between these glass plates can display detailed monochromatic images when connected to the proper equipment.
name: Quicksilver Visualizer

title: Flavorless Paste
abilityDescription: Increase Max Health by |cffffff0|r for |cffffff1.1|r hours.
flavorText: A thick yet rheumy substance produced within the Clockwork City. Though quite filling, and rather healthy, it is food devoid of pleasure.
name: Flavorless Paste

title: Hlaalu Planter, Tall
flavorText: This is a standard house item.
name: Hlaalu Planter, Tall

title: Lantern of Lies
flavorText: The Lantern of Lies traps the souls of liars who gaze upon its flame. Do you dare look? Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: Lantern of Lies

title: Heart of the Indrik
flavorText: The crystallized heart of an Indrik is said to curse any with an unpure heart who touch it. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: Heart of the Indrik

title: The Silver-Tongued Quill
flavorText: Whatever is written with this quill is instantly thought to be true. The trouble comes from the fact that it often has a mind of its own. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: The Silver-Tongued Quill

title: The Unraveling Staff
flavorText: Commissioned by an impatient weaver, this wand can unravel any threads. The trouble comes when it starts to unravel buildings, trees, and even flesh. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: The Unraveling Staff

title: Skull of Minor Cursing
flavorText: Though never known to cause a death, this skull has caused misery to many. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: Skull of Minor Cursing

title: The Shadowcutter Blade
flavorText: This radiant blade creates an arc of light which pierces darkness; even the darkness within the souls of all man and mer. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: The Shadowcutter Blade

title: The Soulkeeper's Urn
flavorText: The container of a powerful spirit, the inscription written upon this urn suggests it was created centuries ago. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: The Soulkeeper's Urn

title: Chest of Condemnation
flavorText: One can hear soft crying from this magically sealed chest, though it is unknown what enchantment or creature produces the sound. Prolonged exposure tends to result in inevitable madness. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: Chest of Condemnation

title: The Never-Ending Scroll
flavorText: This seemingly endless scroll enthralls whoever writes upon it, forcing them to continuously write until they fall dead of exhaustion. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: The Never-Ending Scroll

title: The Inescapable Helm
flavorText: Many have died wearing it, not because of its ineffectiveness but rather because of its curse. Only in death is this miraculous helm unbound from its wearer's head. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: The Inescapable Helm

title: The Sticky-Fingered Lute
flavorText: Created by a merciless music teacher, any who strum the strings of this lute will be unable to put it down until he or she plays the perfect melody. Cruel, but highly effective. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: The Sticky-Fingered Lute

title: Fan of False-Face
flavorText: This fan allows its bearer to steal another's face, though at the cost of slowly losing themselves. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: Fan of False-Face

title: Pillow of Sweet Dreams
flavorText: All who rest their brow upon this pillow are overcome with euphoric dreams. As addictive as it is deadly, for many never awake from their saccharine slumber. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: Pillow of Sweet Dreams

title: Mirror of Fatal Premonition
flavorText: Few dare to gaze upon this mirror, which shows the viewer's face mere moments before their inevitable death. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: Mirror of Fatal Premonition

title: The Monochrome Paintbrush
flavorText: An enchanted brush with the ability to drain the life force of any who use it. For their sacrifice, the most beautiful shades of color are created. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: The Monochrome Paintbrush

title: Hourglass of Perceived Time
flavorText: When activated, this hourglass changes the user's perspective of time. Hours can appear to last days, days can go by in a mere blink. Due to its misuse as a torture device, the secrets of activating its powers remain hidden. Bring this to the Vault of Moaw
name: Hourglass of Perceived Time

title: Jaunt of the Jilted
flavorText: Cursed by a stilted lover, these shoes condemn their wearer to a dancing death. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: Jaunt of the Jilted

title: The Ever-Filling Chalice
flavorText: Those who drink upon this chalice are cursed with an unquenchable thirst. Many have drowned upon its ever-filling waters. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: The Ever-Filling Chalice

title: Chestplate of Desiccation
flavorText: Used by the Telvanni as a torture device for slaves, this amulet will slowly dry out all moisture from the wearer's body. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: Chestplate of Desiccation

title: The Shattering Sword
flavorText: Any blade forged upon this hilt is doomed to shatter within the most crucial time of a battle. Bring this to the Vault of Moawita in Summerset.
name: The Shattering Sword
